bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt" || exit 71
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-0f3633f >/dev/null || exit 73
current="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$current" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 74
proj="$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$current")"
test -n "$proj" && test "$proj" != "<no value>" || exit 75
old="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$current")"
docker image inspect "$old" >/dev/null || exit 76
docker tag "$old" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-dual-20261119 || exit 77
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-0f3633f gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 78
if ! docker compose -p "$proj" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-dual-20261119 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$proj" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 exit 79
fi
now="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$proj" --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$now" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 80
docker exec "$now" sh -c 'test -r /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient && test -r /run/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account' || exit 81
for n in $(seq 1 25); do
 docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && break
 sleep 1
done
docker logs "$now" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 82
pg="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$proj" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test -n "$pg" || exit 83
test "$(docker exec "$pg" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -c "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='gaybbs_bug_report_userbot_delivery';")" = 1 || exit 84
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 85
echo DUAL_REPORT_BOT_LIVE_PASS
